abstract: Humanity's Pathways to 2100 is a flagship scenario monograph within the H Heuristics Polycrisis Resilience Series, based on the concept developed by Hunter Hughes, Founder of H Heuristics (https://polycrisisresilience.hheuristics.com/).

keyFindings.title: Humanity's trajectory toward 2100 is not predetermined: across five illustrative scenarios, the Global Prosperity & Resilience Index (44.0 in 2025) diverges to 92.0 under Sustainable Convergence versus 24.5 under Compounding Polycrisis.

The future depends not simply on how much technological or economic progress occurs, but on how it is distributed, integrated, and translated into reductions in human and systemic vulnerability—bridging Sustainable Convergence, Polycrisis Resilience, and Optimizing Humanity's Outlook.

Under Sustainable Convergence, Global South GDP/capita reaches 86.0% of the OECD frontier, extreme poverty falls to 0.3%, clean-tech diffusion hits 98%, and high environmental exposure drops to 4.5% (versus 74.0% under Compounding Polycrisis).

Evaluating 2100 as an operational benchmark for present-day policy shows Sustainable Convergence delivers a 12.5x 25-year social BCR, compared with 5.2x for Uneven Transformation and 1.5x for Fragmented/Compounding relief.
